lines.text: Landing at Ian Fleming near Ocho Rios? Check this first.
Customs and immigration run daily from seven in the morning to seven in the evening; outside those hours, prior notice is required.
Fill in the immigration and customs C5 form online before you fly.
And leave meat and dairy products at home.
Then pick your ride before you land: transfer, taxi or rental.
Compare partner transfers through the link in the description. If you book through our links we may earn a commission, at no extra cost to you.
